items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآتِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him. Indeed You do not break Your promise.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin wa atihil-wasilata wal-fadhilata wad-darajatar-rafi'ata, wab'athul-maqamal-mahmudal-ladhi wa'adtahu, innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَظِّمْ شَأْنَهُ وَبَيِّنْ بُرْهَانَهُ وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُ وَبَيِّنْ فَضِيلَتَهُ وَتَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ فِي أُمَّتِهِ وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا بِسُنَّتِهِ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ. اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ احْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ وَتَحْتَ لِوَائِهِ وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَحَبَّتِهِ آمِينَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, magnify his standing, make manifest his proof, make clear his argument, make plain his excellence, and accept his intercession for his nation, and employ us by his way, O Lord of the worlds, O Lord of the Great Throne. O Allah, my Lord, gather us in his company and beneath his banner, and give us to drink from his cup, and benefit us through love of him. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.
items.translit: Allahumma 'azzim sha'nahu wa bayyin burhanahu wa ablij hujjatahu wa bayyin fadhilatahu wa taqabbal shafa'atahu fi ummatihi wasta'milna bi-sunnatihi, ya Rabbal-'alamin, ya Rabbal-'arshil-'azim. Allahumma ya Rabbi-hshurna fi zumratihi wa tahta liwa'ihi wasqina bika'sihi wanfa'na bi-mahabbatihi amin ya Rabbal-'alamin.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ بَلِّغْهُ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ السَّلَامِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ بِهِ نَبِيًّا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, my Lord, convey to him from us the best of greetings, and reward him on our behalf with the best that You have rewarded any prophet on behalf of his nation, O Lord of the worlds.
items.translit: Allahumma ya Rabbi balligh-hu 'anna afdhalas-salam, wajzihi 'anna afdhala ma jazayta bihi nabiyyan 'an ummatihi, ya Rabbal-'alamin.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي وَتَتُوبَ عَلَيَّ وَتُعَافِيَنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْبَلَاءِ وَالْبَلْوَى الْخَارِجِ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَالنَّازِلِ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ.
items.en: O Allah, my Lord, I ask You to forgive me, have mercy on me, accept my repentance, and grant me well-being from every trial and affliction that comes from the earth or descends from the sky, indeed You have power over all things, by Your mercy; and to forgive the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead.
items.translit: Allahumma ya Rabbi inni as'aluka an taghfira li wa tarhamani wa tatuba 'alayya wa tu'afiyani min jami'il-bala'i wal-balwal-khariji minal-ardhi wan-nazili minas-sama', innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, bi-rahmatika, wa an taghfira lil-mu'minina wal-mu'minati wal-muslimina wal-muslimatil-ahya'i minhum wal-amwat.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ الْأَرْوَاحِ وَالْأَجْسَادِ الْبَالِيَةِ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِطَاعَةِ الْأَرْوَاحِ الرَّاجِعَةِ إِلَى أَجْسَادِهَا، وَبِطَاعَةِ الْأَجْسَادِ الْمُلْتَئِمَةِ بِعُرُوقِهَا بِكَلِمَاتِكَ النَّافِذَةِ فِيهِمْ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ نُورًا فِي بَصَرِي، وَذِكْرَكَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ عَلَى لِسَانِي، وَعَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَارْزُقْنِي.
items.en: O Allah, Lord of the souls and the decayed bodies, I ask You by the obedience of the souls returning to their bodies, and by the obedience of the bodies rejoined with their veins by Your words penetrating within them, to place light in my sight, and Your remembrance upon my tongue by night and by day, and grant me righteous deeds.
items.translit: Allahumma Rabbal-arwahi wal-ajsadil-baliyah, as'aluka bi-ta'atil-arwahir-raji'ati ila ajsadiha, wa bi-ta'atil-ajsadil-multa'imati bi-'uruqiha bi-kalimatikan-nafidhati fihim, an taj'ala nuran fi basari, wa dhikraka bil-layli wan-nahari 'ala lisani, wa 'amalan salihan farzuqni.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ. اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا جَعَلْتَهَا عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim, and bless our master Muhammad just as You blessed our master Ibrahim. O Allah, place Your blessings and Your benedictions upon our master Muhammad just as You placed them upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahim. Allahummaj'al salawatika wa barakatika 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin kama ja'altaha 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger, and send blessings upon the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'abdika wa rasulik, wa salli 'alal-mu'minina wal-mu'minati wal-muslimina wal-muslimat.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ وَأَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ وَشَهِدَتْ بِهِ مَلَائِكَتُكَ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً تَدُومُ بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِ اللَّهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, as many as Your knowledge encompasses and Your Book has counted and Your angels have witnessed, an enduring blessing that endures as long as the dominion of Allah endures.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi 'adada ma ahata bihi 'ilmuka wa ahsahu kitabuka wa shahidat bihi mala'ikatuk, salatan da'imatan tadumu bidawami mulkillah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْعِظَامِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي سَمَّيْتَ بِهَا نَفْسَكَ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ، عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّمَاءُ مَبْنِيَّةً وَالْأَرْضُ مَدْحِيَّةً وَالْجِبَالُ مُرْسَاةً وَالْعُيُونُ مُنْفَجِرَةً وَالْأَنْهَارُ مُنْهَمِرَةً وَالشَّمْسُ مُشْرِقَةً وَالْقَمَرُ مُضِيئًا وَالْكَوَاكِبُ مُسْتَنِيرَةً وَالْبِحَارُ مُجْرِيَةً وَالْأَشْجَارُ مُثْمِرَةً.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You by the Great Names, those I know of them and those I do not know, and by the names by which You have named Yourself, those I know of them and those I do not know, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your prophet, and Your messenger, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, the mountains anchored, the springs made to burst forth, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to rise, the moon made luminous, the stars made radiant, the seas made to flow, and the trees made to bear fruit.
items.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka bil-asma'il-'izam, ma 'alimtu minha wa ma lam a'lam, wa bil-asma'il-lati sammayta biha nafsak, ma 'alimtu minha wa ma lam a'lam, an tusalliya 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'abdika wa nabiyyika wa rasulik, 'adada ma khalaqta min qabli an takunas-sama'u mabniyyatan wal-ardhu madhiyyatan wal-jibalu mursatan wal-'uyunu munfajiratan wal-anharu munhamiratan wash-shamsu mushriqatan wal-qamaru mudhi'an wal-kawakibu mustaniratan wal-biharu mujriyatan wal-ashjaru muthmirah.

lessons.title: As Many as Every Grain of Sand

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ عِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ حِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ جُودِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَرْضِكَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your knowledge, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your forbearance, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your words, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your favor, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your generosity, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your heavens, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your earth.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada 'ilmik, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada hilmik, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada kalimatik, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ni'matik, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada judik, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada samawatik, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ardhik.

items.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي أَرْضِكَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَغَيْرِهِمَا مِنَ الْوَحْشِ وَالطَّيْرِ وَغَيْرِهِمَا، وَعَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ الْقَلَمُ فِي عِلْمِ غَيْبِكَ وَمَا يَجْرِي بِهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْقَطْرِ وَالْمَطَرِ.
items.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You created in Your seven heavens of angels, and as many as what You created in Your earth of jinn, humans, and other than them of wild beasts and birds, and as many as what the Pen has recorded in the knowledge of Your unseen and what it will record until the Day of Resurrection, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the drops and the rain.
items.translit: Wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma khalaqta fi sab'i samawatika minal-mala'ikah, wa 'adada ma khalaqta fi ardhika minal-jinni wal-insi wa ghayrihima minal-wahshi wat-tayri wa ghayrihima, wa 'adada ma jara bihil-qalamu fi 'ilmi ghaybika wa ma yajri bihi ila yawmil-qiyamah, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adadal-qatri wal-matar.

items.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ يَحْمَدُكَ وَيَشْكُرُكَ وَيُهَلِّلُكَ وَيُمَجِّدُكَ وَيَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْتَ وَمَلَائِكَتُكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَعَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ.
items.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as those who praise You, thank You, declare Your Oneness, and glorify You, and who witness that You are Allah, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as You and Your angels have blessed him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as those of Your creation who have blessed him and as many as those of Your creation who have not.
items.translit: Wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada man yahmaduka wa yashkuruka wa yuhalliluka wa yumajjiduka wa yashhadu annaka antallah, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma sallayta 'alayhi anta wa mala'ikatuk, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada man salla 'alayhi min khalqika wa 'adada man lam yusalli 'alayhi min khalqik.

items.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْجِبَالِ وَالرِّمَالِ وَالْحَصَى، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الشَّجَرِ وَأَوْرَاقِهَا وَالْمَدَرِ وَأَثْقَالِهَا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ سَنَةٍ وَمَا تَخْلُقُ فِيهَا وَمَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا تَخْلُقُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ وَمَا يَمُوتُ فِيهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
items.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the mountains, the sands, and the pebbles, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the trees and their leaves and the clods of earth and their weights, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as every year and what You create in it and what dies in it, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You create every day and what dies in it until the Day of Resurrection.
items.translit: Wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adadal-jibali war-rimali wal-hasa, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adadash-shajari wa awraqiha wal-madari wa athqaliha, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada kulli sanatin wa ma takhluqu fiha wa ma yamutu fiha, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma takhluqu kulla yawmin wa ma yamutu fihi ila yawmil-qiyamah.

lessons.title: As Many as the Flowing Clouds

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الْجَارِيَةِ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا تُمْطِرُ مِنَ الْمِيَاهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرِّيَاحِ الْمُسَخَّرَاتِ فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي بِحَارِكَ مِنَ الْحِيتَانِ وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالْمِيَاهِ وَالرِّمَالِ وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the clouds flowing between the sky and the earth and the waters they rain down, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the winds made subservient in the east and west of the earth, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the stars of the sky, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You created in Your seas of fish, creatures, waters, sands, and other than that.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adadas-sahabil-jariyati baynas-sama'i wal-ardhi wa ma tumtiru minal-miyah, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adadar-riyahil-musakharati fi mashariqil-ardhi wa magharibiha, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada nujumis-sama', wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma khalaqta fi biharika minal-hitani wad-dawabbi wal-miyahi war-rimali wa ghayri dhalik.

items.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النَّبَاتِ وَالْحَصَى، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النَّمْلِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْمِيَاهِ الْعَذْبَةِ وَالْمِيَاهِ الْمِلْحَةِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نِعْمَتِكَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَا تُحِبُّهُ وَتَرْضَاهُ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَا يُحِبُّكَ وَيَرْضَاكَ.
items.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the vegetation and the pebbles, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the ants, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the fresh waters and the salty waters, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your favor upon all Your creation, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad to the extent that You love and are pleased with him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad to the extent that he loves You and is pleased with You.
items.translit: Wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adadan-nabati wal-hasa, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adadan-naml, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adadal-miyahil-'adhbati wal-miyahil-milhah, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ni'matika 'ala jami'i khalqik, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'ala qadri ma tuhibbuhu wa tardhah, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'ala qadri ma yuhibbuka wa yardhak.

items.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَبَدَ الْآبِدِينَ، وَأَنْزِلْهُ الْمَنْزِلَ الْمُقَرَّبَ عِنْدَكَ، وَآتِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالشَّفَاعَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثِ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ.
items.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad forever and ever, and settle him in the station nearest to You, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, the intercession, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him. Indeed You do not break Your promise.
items.translit: Wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin abadal-abidin, wa anzilhul-manzalal-muqarraba 'indak, wa atihil-wasilata wal-fadhilata wash-shafa'ata wad-darajatar-rafi'ah, wab'athil-maqamal-mahmudal-ladhi wa'adtahu, innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad.

lessons.title: By the Sacred Precincts and the Prophets' Gifts

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّكَ مَالِكِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلَايَ وَثِقَتِي وَرَجَائِي، أَسْأَلُكَ بِحُرْمَةِ الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْبَلَدِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ وَقَبْرِ نَبِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، أَنْ تَهَبَ لِي مِنَ الْخَيْرِ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَتَصْرِفَ عَنِّي مِنَ السُّوءِ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You, for indeed You are my Master, my Lord, my Protector, my confidence, and my hope, I ask You by the sanctity of the sacred month, the sacred city, the sacred site, and the grave of Your Prophet, peace be upon him, to grant me of the good that none knows except You, and to turn away from me the evil that none knows except You.
items.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-annaka maliki wa sayyidi wa mawlaya wa thiqati wa raja'i, as'aluka bi-hurmatish-shahril-harami wal-baladil-harami wal-mash'aril-harami wa qabri nabiyyika 'alayhis-salam, an tahaba li minal-khayri ma la ya'lamu 'ilmahu illa ant, wa tasrifa 'anni minas-su'i ma la ya'lamu 'ilmahu illa ant.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ وَهَبَ لِسَيِّدِنَا آدَمَ سَيِّدَنَا شِيثًا، وَلِسَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ سَيِّدَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَسَيِّدَنَا إِسْحَاقَ، وَرَدَّ سَيِّدَنَا يُوسُفَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا يَعْقُوبَ، وَيَا مَنْ كَشَفَ الْبَلَاءَ عَنْ سَيِّدِنَا أَيُّوبَ.
items.en: O Allah, O You who granted our master Adam our master Sheeth, and granted our master Ibrahim our master Isma'il and our master Ishaq, and returned our master Yusuf to our master Ya'qub, and O You who removed the affliction from our master Ayyub.
items.translit: Allahumma ya man wahaba li-Sayyidina Adama Sayyidana Shithan, wa li-Sayyidina Ibrahima Sayyidana Isma'ila wa Sayyidana Ishaq, wa radda Sayyidana Yusufa 'ala Sayyidina Ya'qub, wa ya man kashafal-bala'a 'an Sayyidina Ayyub.

items.ar: وَيَا مَنْ رَدَّ مُوسَى إِلَى أُمِّهِ، وَيَا زَائِدَ سَيِّدِنَا الْخَضِرِ فِي عِلْمِهِ، وَيَا مَنْ وَهَبَ لِسَيِّدِنَا دَاوُدَ سَيِّدَنَا سُلَيْمَانَ، وَلِسَيِّدِنَا زَكَرِيَّا سَيِّدَنَا يَحْيَى، وَلِسَيِّدَتِنَا مَرْيَمَ سَيِّدَنَا عِيسَى، وَيَا حَافِظَ ابْنَةِ سَيِّدِنَا شُعَيْبٍ.
items.en: And O You who returned Musa to his mother, and O You who increased our master al-Khidr in his knowledge, and O You who granted our master Dawud our master Sulayman, and our master Zakariya our master Yahya, and our lady Maryam our master 'Isa, and O Protector of the daughter of our master Shu'ayb.
items.translit: Wa ya man radda Musa ila ummihi, wa ya za'ida Sayyidinal-Khidhri fi 'ilmihi, wa ya man wahaba li-Sayyidina Dawuda Sayyidana Sulayman, wa li-Sayyidina Zakariyya Sayyidana Yahya, wa li-Sayyidatina Maryama Sayyidana 'Isa, wa ya hafiza ibnati Sayyidina Shu'ayb.

items.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَيَا مَنْ وَهَبَ لِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الشَّفَاعَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَتَسْتُرَ عَلَيَّ عُيُوبِي كُلَّهَا وَتُجِيرَنِي مِنَ النَّارِ.
items.en: I ask You to send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon all the prophets and messengers, and O You who granted our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, intercession and the elevated rank, to forgive me my sins and cover all my faults and grant me refuge from the Fire.
items.translit: As'aluka an tusalliya 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala jami'in-nabiyyina wal-mursalin, wa ya man wahaba li-Sayyidina Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallamash-shafa'ata wad-darajatar-rafi'ah, an taghfira li dhunubi wa tastura 'alayya 'uyubi kullaha wa tujirani minan-nar.

lessons.title: Joy on the Day of Resurrection

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فَرِّحْنَا بِهِ فِي عَرَصَاتِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا دَلِيلًا إِلَى جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ بِلَا مَؤُونَةٍ وَلَا مَشَقَّةٍ وَلَا مُنَاقَشَةِ الْحِسَابِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ مُقْبِلًا عَلَيْنَا وَلَا تَجْعَلْهُ غَاضِبًا عَلَيْنَا.
items.en: O Allah, gladden us with him in the courtyards of Resurrection, and make him for us a guide to the Garden of Bliss without hardship, without difficulty, and without a searching reckoning, and make him well-disposed toward us, and do not make him angry with us.
items.translit: Allahumma farrihna bihi fi 'arasatil-qiyamah, waj'alhu lana dalilan ila jannatin-na'imi bila mu'natin wa la mashaqqatin wa la munaqashatil-hisab, waj'alhu muqbilan 'alayna wa la taj'alhu ghadhiban 'alayna.

items.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِوَالِدَيْنَا وَلِجَمِيعِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ، وَآخِرُ دَعْوَانَا أَنِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
items.en: And forgive us and our parents and all the Muslims, the living among them and the dead, and the last of our prayer is that all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
items.translit: Waghfir lana wa li-walidayna wa li-jami'il-muslimina-l-ahya'i minhum wal-amwat, wa akhiru da'wana anil-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin.

items.ar: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ.
items.en: So I ask You, O Allah, O Allah, O Living, O Eternal, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor: there is no god except You. Glory be to You! Surely I have been a wrong-doer.
items.translit: Fa-as'aluka ya Allahu ya Allahu ya Hayyu ya Qayyumu ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram, la ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.

items.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا حَمَلَ كُرْسِيُّكَ مِنْ عَظَمَتِكَ وَجَلَالِكَ وَبَهَائِكَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ، وَبِحَقِّ أَسْمَائِكَ الْمَخْزُونَةِ الْمَكْنُونَةِ الْمُطَهَّرَةِ الَّتِي لَمْ يَطَّلِعْ عَلَيْهَا أَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَبِحَقِّ الِاسْمِ الَّذِي وَضَعْتَهُ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ فَأَظْلَمَ وَعَلَى النَّهَارِ فَاسْتَنَارَ وَعَلَى السَّمَاوَاتِ فَاسْتَقَلَّتْ.
items.en: I ask You by what Your Chair bears of Your greatness, Your majesty, Your splendor, Your power, and Your dominion, and by the right of Your treasured, hidden, purified Names which none of Your creation has been shown, and by the right of the Name which You placed upon the night and it grew dark, and upon the day and it shone with light, and upon the heavens and they became lifted.
items.translit: As'aluka bima hamala kursiyyuka min 'azamatika wa jalalika wa baha'ika wa qudratika wa sultanik, wa bi-haqqi asma'ikal-makhzunatil-maknunatil-mutahharatil-lati lam yattali' 'alayha ahadun min khalqik, wa bi-haqqil-ismil-ladhi wadha'tahu 'alal-layli fa-azlam wa 'alan-nahari fastanara wa 'alas-samawati fastaqallat.

items.ar: وَعَلَى الْأَرْضِ فَاسْتَقَرَّتْ، وَعَلَى الْبِحَارِ فَانْفَجَرَتْ، وَعَلَى الْعُيُونِ فَنَبَعَتْ، وَعَلَى السَّحَابِ فَأَمْطَرَتْ. وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا إِسْرَافِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْعَرْشِ وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْكُرْسِيِّ.
items.en: And upon the earth and it became settled, and upon the seas and they burst forth, and upon the springs and they gushed, and upon the clouds and they rained. And I ask You by the names written on the brow of our master Jibril, peace be upon him, and by the names written on the brow of our master Israfil, peace be upon him, and upon all the angels, and I ask You by the names written around the Throne and by the names written around the Chair.
items.translit: Wa 'alal-ardhi fastaqarrat, wa 'alal-bihari fanfajarat, wa 'alal-'uyuni fanaba'at, wa 'alas-sahabi fa-amtarat. Wa as'aluka bil-asma'il-maktubati fi jabhati Sayyidina Jibrila 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-maktubati fi jabhati Sayyidina Israfila 'alayhis-salamu wa 'ala jami'il-mala'ikah, wa as'aluka bil-asma'il-maktubati hawlal-'arshi wa bil-asma'il-maktubati hawlal-kursiyy.

items.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْأَعْظَمِ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ أَسْمَائِكَ كُلِّهَا، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ.
items.en: And I ask You by Your Greatest Name by which You have named Yourself, and I ask You by the right of all Your Names, those I know of them and those I do not know.
items.translit: Wa as'aluka bismikal-a'zamil-ladhi sammayta bihi nafsak, wa as'aluka bi-haqqi asma'ika kulliha, ma 'alimtu minha wa ma lam a'lam.

items.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا آدَمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا نُوحٌ، وَسَيِّدُنَا صَالِحٌ، وَسَيِّدُنَا يَعْقُوبُ، وَسَيِّدُنَا يُوسُفُ، وَسَيِّدُنَا يُونُسُ، وَسَيِّدُنَا مُوسَى، وَسَيِّدُنَا هَارُونُ، وَسَيِّدُنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ.
items.en: And I ask You by the names by which our master Adam called upon You, peace be upon him, and by which our master Nuh, our master Salih, our master Ya'qub, our master Yusuf, our master Yunus, our master Musa, our master Harun, and our master Shu'ayb called upon You, peace be upon them.
items.translit: Wa as'aluka bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Adamu 'alayhis-salam, wa billati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Nuhun, wa Sayyiduna Salihun, wa Sayyiduna Ya'qubu, wa Sayyiduna Yusufu, wa Sayyiduna Yunusu, wa Sayyiduna Musa, wa Sayyiduna Harunu, wa Sayyiduna Shu'aybun, 'alayhimus-salam.

items.ar: وَسَيِّدُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، وَسَيِّدُنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، وَسَيِّدُنَا دَاوُدُ، وَسَيِّدُنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، وَسَيِّدُنَا زَكَرِيَّا، وَسَيِّدُنَا يَحْيَى، وَسَيِّدُنَا يُوشَعُ، وَسَيِّدُنَا الْخَضِرُ، وَسَيِّدُنَا إِلْيَاسُ، وَسَيِّدُنَا الْيَسَعُ، وَسَيِّدُنَا ذُو الْكِفْلِ، وَسَيِّدُنَا عِيسَى، وَسَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَبِيُّكَ وَرَسُولُكَ وَحَبِيبُكَ وَصَفِيُّكَ.
items.en: And our master Ibrahim, our master Isma'il, our master Dawud, our master Sulayman, our master Zakariya, our master Yahya, our master Yusha', our master al-Khidr, our master Ilyas, our master al-Yasa', our master Dhul-Kifl, our master 'Isa, and our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, Your prophet, Your messenger, Your beloved, and Your chosen one.
items.translit: Wa Sayyiduna Ibrahimu, wa Sayyiduna Isma'ilu, wa Sayyiduna Dawudu, wa Sayyiduna Sulaymanu, wa Sayyiduna Zakariyya, wa Sayyiduna Yahya, wa Sayyiduna Yusha'u, wa Sayyidunal-Khidhr, wa Sayyiduna Ilyasu, wa Sayyidunal-Yasa'u, wa Sayyiduna Dhul-Kifli, wa Sayyiduna 'Isa, wa Sayyiduna Muhammadun sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, nabiyyuka wa rasuluka wa habibuka wa safiyyuk.

lessons.title: A Vision of the Noble Face

items.ar: يَا مَنْ قَالَ وَقَوْلُهُ الْحَقُّ: ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾، وَلَا يَصْدُرُ عَنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ عَبِيدِهِ قَوْلٌ وَلَا فِعْلٌ وَلَا حَرَكَةٌ وَلَا سُكُونٌ إِلَّا وَقَدْ سَبَقَ فِي عِلْمِهِ وَقَضَائِهِ وَقَدَرِهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَرْزُقَنِي وَكُلَّ مَنْ أَحَبَّهُ وَاتَّبَعَهُ شَفَاعَتَهُ وَمُرَافَقَتَهُ يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ.
items.en: O You who said, and Your word is the truth: 'And Allah created you and what you do.' And no word, no deed, no movement, and no stillness proceeds from any of His servants except that it has already preceded in His knowledge, His decree, and His measure. I ask You to grant me and everyone who loves him and follows him his intercession and his companionship on the Day of Reckoning.
items.translit: Ya man qala wa qawluhul-haqq: wallahu khalaqakum wa ma ta'malun, wa la yasduru 'an ahadin min 'abidihi qawlun wa la fi'lun wa la harakatun wa la sukunun illa wa qad sabaqa fi 'ilmihi wa qadha'ihi wa qadarih, as'aluka an tarzuqani wa kulla man ahabbahu wattaba'ahu shafa'atahu wa murafaqatahu yawmal-hisab.

items.ar: وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَتَسْتُرَ عُيُوبِي يَا وَهَّابُ يَا غَفَّارُ، وَأَنْ تُنَعِّمَنِي بِالنَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ فِي جُمْلَةِ الْأَحْبَابِ يَوْمَ الْمَزِيدِ وَالثَّوَابِ.
items.en: And to forgive me my sins and cover my faults, O Bestower, O Forgiver, and to bless me with looking upon Your noble Face among the beloved ones on the Day of Increase and Reward.
items.translit: Wa an taghfira li dhunubi wa tastura 'uyubi ya Wahhabu ya Ghaffar, wa an tuna'imani bin-nazri ila wajhikal-karimi fi jumlatil-ahbabi yawmal-mazidi wath-thawab.

items.ar: وَأَنْ تَتَقَبَّلَ مِنِّي عَمَلِي، وَأَنْ تَعْفُوَ عَمَّا أَحَاطَ عِلْمُكَ بِهِ مِنْ خَطِيئَتِي وَنِسْيَانِي وَزَلَلِي، وَأَنْ تُبَلِّغَنِي مِنْ زِيَارَةِ قَبْرِهِ وَالتَّسْلِيمِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى صَاحِبَيْهِ غَايَةَ أَمَلِي، بِمَنِّكَ وَفَضْلِكَ وَجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ يَا رَؤُوفُ يَا رَحِيمُ يَا وَلِيُّ.
items.en: And to accept from me my deeds, and to pardon what Your knowledge encompasses of my errors, my forgetfulness, and my slips, and to bring me to the utmost of my hope in visiting his grave and greeting him and his two companions with peace, by Your grace, Your favor, Your generosity, and Your bounty, O Kind, O Merciful, O Protector.
items.translit: Wa an tataqabbala minni 'amali, wa an ta'fuwa 'amma ahata 'ilmuka bihi min khati'ati wa nisyani wa zalali, wa an tuballighani min ziyarati qabrihi wat-taslimi 'alayhi wa 'ala sahibayhi ghayata amali, bi-mannika wa fadhlika wa judika wa karamika ya Ra'ufu ya Rahimu ya Waliyy.

items.ar: وَأَنْ تُجَازِيَهُ عَنِّي وَعَنْ كُلِّ مَنْ آمَنَ بِهِ وَاتَّبَعَهُ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ أَفْضَلَ وَأَتَمَّ وَأَعَمَّ مَا جَازَيْتَ بِهِ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، يَا قَوِيُّ يَا عَزِيزُ يَا عَلِيُّ.
items.en: And to reward him on my behalf and on behalf of everyone who believed in him and followed him among the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, with the best, most complete, and most comprehensive reward You have given anyone of Your creation, O Strong, O Mighty, O Most High.
items.translit: Wa an tujaziyahu 'anni wa 'an kulli man amana bihi wattaba'ahu minal-muslimina wal-muslimatil-ahya'i minhum wal-amwati afdhala wa atamma wa a'amma ma jazayta bihi ahadan min khalqika, ya Qawiyyu ya 'Azizu ya 'Aliyy.

items.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ مَا أَقْسَمْتُ بِهِ عَلَيْكَ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّمَاءُ مَبْنِيَّةً وَالْأَرْضُ مَدْحِيَّةً وَالْجِبَالُ عُلْوِيَّةً وَالْعُيُونُ مُنْفَجِرَةً وَالْبِحَارُ مُسَخَّرَةً وَالْأَنْهَارُ مُنْهَمِرَةً وَالشَّمْسُ مُضِيئَةً وَالْقَمَرُ مُضِيئًا وَالنَّجْمُ مُنِيرًا، وَلَا يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ حَيْثُ تَكُونُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
items.en: And I ask You, O Allah, by the right of what I have sworn to You by, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, the mountains raised, the springs made to burst forth, the seas made subservient, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to shine, the moon made luminous, and the star made radiant, and none knows where You are except You.
items.translit: Wa as'alukallahumma bi-haqqi ma aqsamtu bihi 'alayk, an tusalliya 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma khalaqta min qabli an takunas-sama'u mabniyyatan wal-ardhu madhiyyatan wal-jibalu 'ulwiyyatan wal-'uyunu munfajiratan wal-biharu musakharatan wal-anharu munhamiratan wash-shamsu mudhi'atan wal-qamaru mudhi'an wan-najmu muniran, wa la ya'lamu ahadun haythu takunu illa ant.

items.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ كَلَامِي، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ آيَاتِ الْقُرْآنِ وَحُرُوفِهِ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَنْ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَعَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ مِلْءَ أَرْضِكَ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ الْقَلَمُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ.
items.en: And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as my words, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the verses of the Quran and its letters, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as those who bless him and as many as those who do not, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family filling Your earth, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the Pen has recorded in the Mother of the Book.
items.translit: Wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada kalami, wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada ayatil-qur'ani wa hurufih, wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada man yusalli 'alayhi wa 'adada man lam yusalli 'alayh, wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi mil'a ardhik, wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada ma jara bihil-qalamu fi ummil-kitab.

items.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ فِيهِنَّ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ قَطْرِ الْمَطَرِ وَكُلِّ قَطْرَةٍ قَطَرَتْ مِنْ سَمَائِكَ إِلَى أَرْضِكَ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
items.en: And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You created in Your seven heavens, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You will create in them until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the drops of rain and every drop that has fallen from Your sky to Your earth from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
items.translit: Wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada ma khalaqta fi sab'i samawatik, wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada ma anta khaliquhu fihinna ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah, wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada qatril-matari wa kulli qatratin qatarat min sama'ika ila ardhika min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
